name: roll chest opener lying on floor
description: Lie across a foam roller under the upper back and open the arms to gently mobilize the upper spine and chest.
instructions: Place a foam roller across your upper back and lie on it with your knees bent and feet planted.
Support your head if needed and open your arms out to the sides.
Let your upper back extend gently over the roller while you breathe steadily, without forcing your lower back to arch.
Move the roller a small distance along the upper back to find a comfortable stretch, then come up slowly.
